votes.motion: Approve the minutes of Tuesday, May 19, 2020
votes.description: The Board approved the meeting minutes from the May 19, 2020 RDA meeting.

votes.motion: Approve RDA Resolution 13 of 2021, Utah Performing Arts Center Interlocal Agreement
votes.description: The Board ratified execution of a second amendment to an interlocal agreement between Salt Lake City, the RDA, and UPACA for operation of the George S. and Delores Dore Eccles Theater.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purposes of strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange or lease of real property, discussion of pending or reasonably imminent litigation, and advice of Counsel
votes.description: The Board voted to enter a closed session to discuss real property transactions, pending or reasonably imminent litigation, and attorney-client matters.
